title: TorchQL: A Programming Framework for Integrity Constraints in Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting noun-adjective pairs from the training dataset using NLP parsing to identify adjectives highly correlated with specific professions (e.g., 'farmer' vs. 'engineer'), followed by a counterfactual experiment prompting the language model in a multiple-choice format to quantify how frequently it selects the biased adjective to describe the corresponding profession.
